motivation.j_directive_2026_07_31: we're paper trading. We have six arms, and we should just be getting in shit and seeing if it works.
motivation.j_market_view: the market's dynamic... the same thing that worked on day 372 ago is not gonna work on day 162 ago
motivation.observed_2026_07_31: risky-3 (the only arm reaching the signal at a clearing premium) entered and won; risky-1 logged 128 HOLDs and ZERO trades.
motivation.doctrine_constraint: ARMS ARE RISK PROFILES, NOT STRATEGIES (memory: feedback_arms_are_risk_profiles_not_strategies). FULL-SEND trades the SAME validated setups. What differs: how much COHORT-LEVEL VETOING it inherits, and how small it sizes.

hypothesis: A FULL-SEND risk profile -- identical validated setups, cohort-level vetoes NOT inherited, hard-clamped to minimum size -- materially raises FILLS PER DAY (the learning rate) at a BOUNDED P&L cost. Its job is evidence generation, not P&L.
secondary_metrics: total real-OPRA P&L (disclosed, expected NEGATIVE vs the gated baseline)

pre_registered_failure_conditions._doc: These are the conditions under which the arm is NOT shipped, or is de-armed after shipping. MERELY UNPROFITABLE IS NOT A FAILURE -- that is the expected outcome and the accepted price of the learning rate.
pre_registered_failure_conditions.F1_kill_switch_breach: Any single replay day where the full-send profile's own day P&L is <= -50% of that day's start-of-day equity (the Bold kill-switch threshold). A profile that trips the daily kill switch is a hole, not a learning arm.
pre_registered_failure_conditions.F2_per_trade_bound: Full-send's WORST single-trade dollar loss exceeds the gated baseline's worst single-trade dollar loss. Min-size must make the tail SMALLER in dollars; if it does not, the sizing clamp is not doing its job.
pre_registered_failure_conditions.F3_risk_guard_bypass: Any guard test proving kill switch / risk gate / no-add / EOD-flatten still binds on the arm FAILS. This is an absolute bar -- no P&L result overrides it.
pre_registered_failure_conditions.F4_no_learning_uplift: Full-send admits < 2.0x the gated baseline's trades over the same window. The arm's entire justification is fills/day; below 2x it is not buying enough evidence to be worth any P&L cost.

explicitly_not_failure: Negative aggregate P&L vs the gated arms (EXPECTED -- report it, do not hide it)
Worse per-trade expectancy than the control arms
guards_that_stay_on: daily loss kill switch (Rule 5, per-account, isolated)
SIGHT-FAILURE block (SKIP_NO_LEVELS) -- blindness is not a veto, it is an inability to see; no tier trades through it
no level -> no trade (a full-send entry is never stop-less)

vetoes_that_drop._class: COHORT / TIER vetoes only -- backward-looking population filters fitted on a prior regime
vetoes_that_drop.justification: Every one is a backward-looking cohort filter whose evidence is a prior VIX/structure regime (C22, C23). J's standing rule is that a gate needs live provenance or it dies; this arm converts each into FORWARD evidence at minimum size instead of silence.

vetoes_that_do_NOT_drop: SKIP_EARLY_ENTRY / SKIP_LATE_ENTRY / SKIP_STALE_TRIGGER (time gates -- entry was never actionable at this wall clock)
SKIP_STRUCTURE_VETO (structural, and the 2026-07-30 blindness cluster sits behind it)

method.engine: backtest/lib/orchestrator.py run_backtest(use_real_fills=True) -- REAL OPRA fills only, no synthetic
method.arms_compared: BASELINE (cohort gates ON, as shipped) vs FULL_SEND (the 5 cohort gates OFF); IDENTICAL sizing/exits so the delta isolates SELECTION
method.sizing_disclosure: the A/B runs at identical equity/risk-cap so selection is isolated; the live arm additionally hard-clamps qty to min_contracts, which scales per-trade P&L DOWN roughly linearly (exits are per-contract percentages). Both raw and min-size-scaled figures are reported.
method.windows: recent window AND full population, both reported; no cherry-picking of either

reporting_commitment: ALL cells reported including the ones that make the arm look bad. If FULL_SEND is worse on aggregate P&L -- which is the expectation -- that number is headlined, not buried.
